debt_gdp.label: General government gross debt, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

deficit.label: General government net lending/borrowing, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

fdi.label: FDI net inflows, % of GDP (World Bank)

current_account.label: Current account balance, % of GDP (World Bank)

exports.label: Exports of goods, free on board (IMF international trade in goods, not seasonally adjusted, converted from US$ at each month's average rate)

imports.label: Imports of goods, cost, insurance and freight (IMF international trade in goods, not seasonally adjusted, converted from US$ at each month's average rate)

trade_balance.label: Trade balance, goods, exports free on board less imports cost, insurance and freight (IMF international trade in goods, not seasonally adjusted, converted from US$ at each month's average rate)

cpi.label: CPI, all items, YoY (OECD live prices system)

cpi_mom.label: CPI, all items, MoM (OECD live prices system)

population.label: Population, total, mid-year estimate, annual (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL)

gdp_per_capita.label: GDP per person, current prices, calendar year (GDP divided by World Bank population)

ppp.label: PPP conversion factor, GDP (local currency per international $)
ppp.source: World Bank, PPP conversion factor, GDP (LCU per international $) (PA.NUS.PPP), annual
